notes.title: New karts! More music! Increased player cap!
notes.content:
Have fun!

[h1]Changes v1.3.0[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add 3 new and equally bad karts: a small pickup truck, a locomotive and a minibus
[*] Increase max player count from 12 to 20
[*] Add 2 more songs from my very talented friend Per! The game now features 4 tracks in total, stay tuned for the album release ;)
[/list]

notes.title: Seaside Saturday is now 19:00 UTC
notes.content:
The first Seaside Saturday was a great success, we had 6 players online at the same time! For future events, I've changed the start time to 19:00 UTC.

Spread the word!

[h3]Changes v1.2.10[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix bug in 'Seaside Saturday' countdown and change it to 19:00 UTC
[/list]

notes.title: Seaside Saturday + Purple color (!)
notes.content:
To facilitate spontaneous encounters online given the game's small player base, there is now a countdown to 'Seaside Saturday' on the start screen! This is a scheduled time slot on Saturdays 21:00 UTC during which one can start or join a race if there are others wanting to play.

[h3]Changes v1.2.9[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add countdown to 'Seaside Saturday'
[*] Add purple kart color (!)
[/list]

notes.title: Small but important update for non-English speaking players
notes.content:
A Japanese player alerted me to a crash related to non-English speakers. Unfortunately, the game does not support non-English characters in Steam nicknames. The crash should now be fixed and the game should be able to handle such nicknames gracefully!

Thanks for letting me know about this problem!

[h3]Changes v1.2.8[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix crash from main menu when a Steam user has international characters in their Steam nickname
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Deck and Linux now supported!
notes.content:
The latest update adds Steam Deck and Linux support to the game! Windows, Steam Deck and Linux players can now all be in the same multiplayer games together.

Also, thanks for playing the game! If you enjoy it, please consider sharing it with your friends or writing a good review :)

[h3]Changes v1.2.6[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add Steam Deck/Linux build of the game
[/list]

notes.title: Second post-launch update
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thanks for buying/showing interest in the game!

I found the crash I was referring to in the previous update and it's now fixed.

[h3]Changes v1.2.5[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix crash on race finish when the settings menu had been opened from the main menu first
[*] Minor UI tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: First post-launch update
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thanks for buying/showing interest in the game!

I've noticed occasional crashes when a race finishes and while I haven't been able to reproduce the problem in a debug build yet, I did find a bug related to this. To be proactive I'm releasing a fix for this bug now even though I have yet to pinpoint the reason for the crash.

[h3]Changes v1.2.4[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix minor bug related to finishing a race
[*] Move "Switch character" from pause menu to key-bind when on starting line (see on-screen help)
[/list]
